scope: Three specified post-35b ROUND32 findings plus explicit-RMB angle-word source-cropping intersection.
counting: 20 Node test containers with finite loops, not 20 independent real materials and not a benchmark score.

observed_boundaries.approximate_have: 约有/大约有/将近有 whole -> approximate/null; fresh cropped short/fullquote and adjacentblock unavailable; stored exact is downgraded; stored null stays null.
observed_boundaries.date_attribution: The two reported wage schedule layouts and a bounded traditional recurring alias receive payment_date support. Wrong beneficiary, negation, other owner, wrong role and invalid day controls stay unsupported. This is scheduled payment timing, not receipt.
observed_boundaries.ordinary_count_words: 五角星/三角洲/八角亭/五角大楼 are definite non-money only when the counted expression is complete. New runtime candidates are rejected with raw retained; old stored extractions are preserved with amount null.
observed_boundaries.explicit_rmb_intersection: 人民币五角星 no longer exposes .50, including both clipped value/quote, full quote, neighboring block and stored exact .50. Explicit RMB prefix leaves the candidate reviewable (accepted1, amount null), rather than claiming every ordinary noun is rejected.
observed_boundaries.precision_controls: 4000元, 有4000元 and 人民币五角/人民币五角钱 remain exact in the covered controls; bare 五角钱 remains reviewable/null. Different owner or independent sentence does not transfer an estimate or ordinary-word boundary.

analysis.conclusion: Only literal 有 is added to the existing attached prefix bridge. Qualifier, raw-span handling and the subject/number/punctuation barriers are unchanged.

A complete valid recurring payment date and closed wage/payment envelopes may establish scheduled wage payment attribution after the existing individual-owner checks. This branch does not establish receipt or a money total.
One shared finite angle-word family is used for whole counted nouns and existing matched-token/source-edge guards. Only detection copies fold whitespace; original source/CP remains unchanged.

Complete counted angle nouns are checked before the explicit-subunit branch; arbitrary prose and unknown suffixes are not force-rejected. Explicit RMB ordinary nouns stay reviewable with unavailable amount; genuine RMB subunits retain .50.
